summary:
Main
Both of today's developments point the same way: yesterday's encouraging signals were not solid. First, futures and spot swapped roles- the DCE most-traded contract rose 1.5 yuan to 709.0 yuan/mt, its first gain after six sessions lower, while spot fell another 2 yuan across the board and Carajas fines and PB lump, which led yesterday's turn, gave back 2 yuan each. High grade's solo run lasted a single session.
